segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Cassian glanced at the split skin on her knuckles.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: He laughed, despite trying not to. Then he cleaned her knee with water from a bottle, tearing a strip from an old cloth when they ran out of proper bandages. She hissed when the cold water touched the scrape.

segments.speaker: cassian
segments.text: Yes. That's the treatment. All doctors do it.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: When he was done, he crouched in front of her and held out his hands.

segments.speaker: cassian
segments.text: Okay. Here's the important part. If somebody bigger than you starts trouble, you don't have to stand there and prove you're fearless.

segments.speaker: cassian
segments.text: Then you should've been. Fear can be useful.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: She hated that answer. Cassian tilted his head.

segments.speaker: cassian
segments.text: Look at me. Nin. Being brave isn't the same as being stupid.

segments.speaker: cassian
segments.text: Frequently. That's how I've gathered all this wisdom.
